title: Sam's Pizza
author: Gus
body:
## *I wish I knew*

*I remember working at Sam's I look at it really fondly because it's when I was really discovering my own music scene with HKCR it was peak covid with amazing sets from Online Threat, Fingergap, and The Heman to name a few.*

![](../Editorial-images/20200626081626.gif "Sam's love")

Above is a gif from the views I had working at Sam's I wish I could work there if only car issues were not a thing. It's definitely a time I look back on fondly. Anyways below is a small playlist of tracks I would listen to when delivering pizza.
